questions.subject: chemistry
questions.content: Identify the correct statements regarding enzymes

options.content:
Enzymes are specific biological catalysts that can normally function at very high
temperature (T ~ 1000 K)
Enzymes are specific biological catalysts that the posses well – defined active sites
Enzymes are specific biological catalysts that can not be poisoned
Enzymes are normally heterogeneous catalysts that are very specific in their action

questions.explanation: Enzymes are shape selective specific biological  catalysts which normally functions effectively at body temperature.
